title: Characters glance at passing life
description: Let a character turn their head toward whatever just leapt, landed or flew past (any system calls `KIT.ping`), glancing for a couple of seconds and then resting, so ambient life never pins the gaze. Component: 3d/godot/world_life/attention_glance.gd (world-life module). Derived from ShammyVerse.

optional_ai: Wiring the component into the game; a person reviews the result in play.

stages.title: Vendor the world-life module
stages.description: Copy the kit and components into the game with a SHA-256 lock per file.

stages.title: Wire the component
stages.description: Game code: Ambient systems call `KIT.ping(at, strength, seconds)` on events worth a glance: a leap, a landing, a cannon, a note. Each frame the character's rig calls `glance.update(delta, head_transform, forward, available)`. Add `glance.offset()` (yaw, pitch) to the neck and head bones, split about 35/65. Blink or raise the brows when `born` changes. `reach`, `max_yaw`, `max_pitch`, `glance_seconds`, `rest_seconds`, `weak`/`near` (weak pings count only up close).

stages.title: Test
stages.description: Headless test on a fixed clock (the GameCore component test, plus the game's own).

checks.title: A ping in front turns the head; it rests after a glance
